final: WITH funding AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), compared AS (SELECT fundflux, avg_y_vs_x_difference, area_to_volume_ratio, AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) OVER () AS avg_ratio FROM funding) SELECT fundflux, avg_y_vs_x_difference, area_to_volume_ratio, area_to_volume_ratio - avg_ratio AS amount_above_average FROM compared WHERE area_to_volume_ratio > avg_ratio ORDER BY fundflux
